title: For separable graded A and sigma-unital graded B, stable homotopy of unbounded Kasparov modules modulo spectral decomposability is identified with KK(A,B) by the bounded transform
author: Jens Kaad
work: On the Unbounded Picture of KK-Theory
source_version: Official SIGMA 16 (2020) article 082, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2020.082; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-09-30, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The new obligation is injectivity at the unbounded-cycle level: lifting a bounded homotopy alone does not connect its endpoints to the original unbounded operators. The author regularizes and doubles the operators, constructs an explicit rotated homotopy for cycles sharing a phase, and verifies its domain, compactness and graded-commutator requirements. This closes a nontrivial unbounded KK-theory equivalence and requires substantially more than a standard bounded functional-calculus exercise.

source_check.note: The complete original Theorem 7.1 and full author proof are retained. All new Sections 4–6 are included because they supply the spectral-degeneracy null class, homotopy gluing isometry and adjoint, bounded perturbation homotopy, Lipschitz regularization, invertible doubling and phase-comparison rotation on which the main injectivity argument depends. Standing assumptions and bounded/unbounded Kasparov definitions are retained. The cited prior Baaj–Julg lifting theorem remains a standard prerequisite, and is not recursively reproved. Existing approved human statement/proof/context/above-qualification decision copied from the frozen manifest and metadata; no new source or mathematical review.

proof_review.note: The full new Sections4–7 proof was read: spectral-degeneracy null class, gluing via the explicit stabilization isometry, bounded perturbation homotopy, strict-continuous fractional regularization and Lipschitz commutator estimates, invertible doubling, the phase-comparison rotation in6.2, group inverses and final bounded-homotopy lifting/end-point comparison. Theorem3.4 is explicitly the prior Baaj–Julg lifting theorem [2]; its stated compact-operator/domain properties are supplied as context, not counted as a new omitted argument. Routine well-definedness of the explicitly given gluing isometry is left to the reader by the author and retained as such; the construction and adjoint are given.

original_metadata.statement_scope: Exactly Theorem7.1 for Z/2-graded C*-algebras A separable and B sigma-unital, and a fixed norm-dense countably generated graded *-subalgebra script-A of A. UK^top(script-A,B) is formed from unbounded Kasparov modules by unitary equivalence and stable unbounded homotopies after adding spectrally decomposable cycles (Definitions4.1,4.5,4.9–4.10). The Baaj–Julg bounded transform induces an abelian-group isomorphism to KK(A,B). No equality of finer metric/geometric cycles or unbounded Kasparov-product construction is claimed.
